name: tihloh/prefab-auth
description: Standalone, framework-independent authentication building blocks for Prefab PHP.

suggest.tihloh/prefab-users: Optional user provider that Prefab Auth can discover automatically.
suggest.tihloh/prefab-logs: Optional structured activity logging for authentication events.
suggest.league/oauth2-client: Optional generic OAuth 2.0 provider client for social authentication.
suggest.league/oauth2-google: Optional official Google OAuth 2.0 provider client.
suggest.league/oauth2-github: Optional official GitHub OAuth 2.0 provider client.
suggest.league/oauth2-facebook: Optional official Facebook OAuth 2.0 provider client.
